steps_en: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Mix the flour, yeast, salt and sugar. Add the water and mix to form a pliable dough.
Divide the dough in half. Roll one half on a floured surface into a long rectangle about ½ inch thick and 12–15 inches wide.
Spread the chocolate spread over the dough, leaving a border of about 1 inch. Add the sliced bananas and sprinkle with nuts and optional chocolate chips.
Roll the dough up from a long side, keeping the filling inside. Place it on a baking tray and brush it lightly with olive oil.
Let the loaf rise in a warm place for 30 minutes, then bake for 30–35 minutes.
wikibooks:en:105346.notes_en: The dough makes two loaves. Use the remaining dough to repeat the method with the remaining filling or make a separate loaf with a different filling.

steps_en: Bring the water to a boil in a heavy saucepan and add the salt.
Whisk constantly while pouring the cornmeal into the water in a steady stream.
Reduce the heat to a gentle simmer. Cover and cook for about 45 minutes, stirring every 2–3 minutes.
If the polenta gets too thick, stir in a little hot water. Taste for salt and serve hot.
wikibooks:en:6645.notes_en: The source also gives microwave methods. Use a large microwave-safe bowl and stir vigorously between short periods of cooking on medium power until the polenta is thick.

ingredients_en: 1 glass cherry juice from pitted cherries
steps_en: Stir the sugar into the warm water, then add the cherry juice.
Bring to a boil and skim any foam. Cook until the syrup flows from a spoon in a thin stream.
Strain, let cool and serve diluted with still or sparkling water.
wikibooks:en:414652.notes_en: This adaptation uses pitted cherries for the juice.

wikibooks:en:456543.exclude_reason: The fermentation instructions leave raw fish warm for at least 48 hours with no measured salt concentration or controlled temperature.

wikibooks:ru:10126.title_en: Ice Cream Layer Cake with Warm Berry Sauce
steps_en: Slice the cake horizontally into even layers.
Spread ice cream between the layers, reassemble the cake and put it in the freezer until firm.
While the cake freezes, combine the butter, berries, brandy and sugar in a saucepan. Bring the mixture to a boil.
Slice the frozen cake, plate the slices and spoon the warm berry sauce over them.
wikibooks:ru:10126.notes_en: The source gives no ingredient quantities or freezing time.

steps_en: Sort the millet and rinse it with hot water until the rinse water runs clear.
Put the millet in a saucepan with the hot water and salt. Bring to a boil, skim any foam and boil until the water is absorbed.
Stir in the hot milk and simmer over moderate, then low heat until the millet is tender and the porridge thickens.
Stir in the butter and serve.

ingredients_en: 1 kg boneless lamb, beef or veal
steps_en: Rinse the rice. Dice the quince and keep it in cold water while preparing the other ingredients.
Cut the meat into chunks, slice the onion and cut the carrots into strips.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot. Brown the meat, add the onion and cook until golden, then add the carrots and cook until they begin to soften.
Season with salt and pepper. Add enough hot water to cover the meat and vegetables and simmer until the meat starts to soften.
Drain the quince and add it with the raisins. Spread the drained rice over the other ingredients in an even layer. Add enough hot water to just cover the rice.
Cook until most of the water has been absorbed. Cover and cook over low heat until the rice is tender, then let it rest off the heat before serving.
Serve the rice topped with the carrots, onion and meat.
wikibooks:ru:11295.notes_en: The Wikibooks version refers to a separate pilaf method. The cooking sequence here follows the Uzbek pilaf method described in the EEAS World Cookbook.

steps_en: Put the ground coffee in a cezve or a small stovetop coffee pot.
Add the cold water.
Heat gently until the coffee is about to boil, then take the pot off the heat.
Serve with sugar and cream on the side.
Cut the rice cakes into 4 cm lengths. If thick, split them lengthwise into 2–4 pieces. Soak them in cold water for 1 hour, then drain.
Slice the onion and chili, cut the spring onion into short pieces, and cut the fish cakes into squares about 3 cm across.
Combine the water, gochujang, soy sauce and sugar in a pan and bring to a boil. Add the rice cakes, fish cakes and vegetables. Add the noodles and simmer until the rice cakes and noodles are tender.

ingredients_en: 450 ml water, or enough to cover the beans
steps_en: Sort and rinse the beans. Soak them in cold water for at least 4 hours or overnight, then drain and rinse again.
Cover with fresh water and simmer gently until very soft, adding water if needed to keep the beans covered.
Drain and mash the beans, or blend them in batches for a smoother paste.
Stir in the sugar and cook over low heat, stirring, until the sugar dissolves and the paste thickens. Leave to cool.
wikibooks:ru:34357.notes_en: For a smoother paste, press the cooked beans through a sieve before adding the sugar.

ingredients_en: 1 cup water for the dough, plus a splash for the filling
steps_en: Finely chop or mince the beef and pork. Mix with the chopped onions, garlic, salt and pepper. Stir in a little water to moisten the filling.
Mix the flour and egg, adding the water gradually to make a firm dough. Knead until smooth.
Roll out the dough and cut rounds 10–15 cm wide. Place filling in the centre of each round and pleat the edge into a pouch, leaving an opening at the top.
Steam for 15–25 minutes, depending on size, until the filling is cooked through.
wikibooks:ru:11328.notes_en: The source suggests about 100 ml of water in the filling for juicier dumplings and mentions lamb as a traditional alternative.
